pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā upanando sakyaputto sahāyakassa gharaṃ gantvā tassa pajāpatiyā saddhiṃ sayanīghare nisajjaṃ kappesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.3: athakho so puriso yenāyasmā upanando sakyaputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.4: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso pajāpatiṃ etadavoca dehayyassa bhikkhanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.5: athakho sā itthī āyasmato upanandassa sakyaputtassa bhikkhaṃ adāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.6: athakho so puriso āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ etadavoca gacchatha bhante yato ayyassa bhikkhā dinnāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.7: athakho sā itthī sallakkhetvā pariyuṭṭhito ayaṃ purisoti āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ etadavoca nisīdatha bhante mā agamitthāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.9: tatiyampi kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ etadavoca gacchatha bhante yato ayyassa bhikkhā dinnāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.10: tatiyampi kho sā itthī āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ etadavoca nisīdatha bhante mā agamitthāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.11: athakho so puriso nikkhamitvā bhikkhū ujjhāpesi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.12: ayaṃ bhante ayyo upanando mayhaṃ pajāpatiyā saddhiṃ sayanīghare nisinno
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.13: so mayā uyyojiyamāno na icchati gantuṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.15: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.16: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā upanando sakyaputto sabhojane kule anupakhajja nisajjaṃ kappessatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.17: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ upananda sabhojane kule anupakhajja nisajjaṃ kappesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.20: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa sabhojane kule anupakhajja nisajjaṃ kappessasi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.21: netaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.22: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.23.1: yo pana bhikkhu sabhojane kule anupakhajja nisajjaṃ kappeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:2.1.6: itthī ceva hoti puriso ca. ubho anikkhantā honti ubho avītarāgā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:2.1.10: mahallake ghare piṭṭhisaṅghātassa hatthapāsaṃ vijahitvā nisīdati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:2.1.11: khuddake ghare piṭṭhivaṃsaṃ atikkamitvā nisīdati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:2.2.1: sayanīghare sayanīgharasaññī sabhojane kule anupakhajja nisajjaṃ kappeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:2.2.2: sayanīghare vematiko sabhojane kule anupakhajja nisajjaṃ kappeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:2.2.3: sayanīghare nasayanīgharasaññī sabhojane kule anupakhajja nisajjaṃ kappeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
